name: Hormel Foods Corporation
summary_en: Hormel Foods Corporation develops, processes, and distributes various meat, nut, and other food products to foodservice, convenience stores, and commercial customers in the United States and internationally. It operates through three segments: Retail, Foodservice, and International. The company provides perishable products, including fresh meats, frozen items, refrigerated meal solutions, bacon, sausages, hams, guacamole, and other items that require refrigeration, as well as shelf-stable products, such as canned luncheon meats, nut butters, snack nuts, chili, shelf-stable microwaveable meals, hash, stews, tortillas, salsas, tortilla chips, and other items that do not require refrigeration. It sells its products under the HORMEL, ALWAYS TENDER, APPLEGATE, AUSTIN BLUES, BACON 1, BLACK LABEL, BREAD READY, BURKE, CAFÉ H, CERATTI, CHI-CHI'S, COLUMBUS, COMPLEATS, CORN NUTS, CURE 81, DAN'S PRIZE, DI LUSSO, DINTY MOORE, DON MIGUEL, DOÑA MARIA, EMBASA, FAST N EASY, FIRE BRAISED, FONTANINI, HERDEZ, HORMEL GATHERINGS, HOUSE OF TSANG, JENNIE-O, JUSTIN'S, LA VICTORIA, LAYOUT, LLOYD'S, MARY KITCHEN, MR. PEANUT, NATURAL CHOICE, NUT-RITION, OLD SMOKEHOUSE, OVEN READY, PILLOW PACK, PLANTERS, ROSA GRANDE, SADLER'S SMOKEHOUSE, SKIPPY, SPAM, SQUARE TABLE, SPECIAL RECIPE, VALLEY FRESH, and WHOLLY brands through sales personnel, independent brokers, and distributors. The company was formerly known as Geo. A. Hormel & Company and changed its name to Hormel Foods Corporation in January 1995. Hormel Foods Corporation was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Austin, Minnesota.
summary_ko: Hormel Foods Corporation은 다양한 육류, 견과류 및 기타 식품을 미국 및 전 세계의 식품 서비스, 편의점 및 상업 고객에게 개발, 가공 및 배포합니다. 소매, 식품 서비스 및 국제의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 신선한 고기, 냉동 식품, 냉장 식사 용액, 베이컨, 소시지, 햄, 과카몰리 및 냉장이 필요한 기타 품목을 포함하여 부패하기 쉬운 제품뿐만 아니라 통조림 런천 미트, 견과류 버터, 스낵 견과류, 칠리, 전자레인지에 보관 가능한 식품, 해시, 스튜, 토르티야, 살사, 토르티야 칩 및 냉장이 필요하지 않은 기타 품목과 같은 상온 보관 제품도 제공합니다. HORMEL, ALWAYS TENDER, APPLEGATE, AUSTIN BLUES, BACON 1, BLACK LABEL, BREAD READY, BURKE, CAFÉ H, CERATTI, CHI-CHI'S, COLUMBUS, COMPLEATS, CORN NUTS, CURE 81, DAN'S PRIZE, DI LUSSO, DINTY MOORE, DON MIGUEL, DOÑA MARIA, EMBASA, FAST N EASY, FIRE BRAISED, FONTANINI, HERDEZ, HORMEL GATHERINGS, HOUSE OF TSANG, JENNIE-O, JUSTIN'S, LA VICTORIA, 레이아웃, LLOYD'S, MARY KITCHEN, MR. PEANUT, NATURAL CHOICE, NUT-RITION, OLD SMOKEHOUSE, OVEN READY, PILLOW PACK, PLANTERS, ROSA GRANDE, SADLER'S SMOKEHOUSE, SKIPPY, SPAM, SQUARE TABLE, SPECIAL RECIPE, VALLEY FRESH 및 WHOLLY 브랜드를 영업사원, 독립 브로커 및 유통업체를 통해 판매합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Geo로 알려졌습니다. A. Hormel & Company는 1995년 1월에 Hormel Foods Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. Hormel Foods Corporation은 1891년에 설립되었으며 미네소타주 오스틴에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
